title: Bea Millan-Windorski's Miss Universe 2026 national costume places 2nd runner-up
summary: Bea Millan-Windorski’s Diwa ng Kordilyera by Filipino designer Anthony Ramirez earned the second runner-up placement at the 2026 Miss Universe national costume competition, it was announced…

blocks.text: Bea Millan-Windorski’s Diwa ng Kordilyera by Filipino designer Anthony Ramirez earned the second runner-up placement at the 2026 Miss Universe national costume competition, it was announced Saturday, Nov. 28 (Philippine time). Windorski’s placement came after Bangladesh secured first runner-up and Cuba took the Best National Costume title. The winners were determined through fan voting. “Glad to amplify the message of respecting ancestral lands and indigenous communities across the Universe,” Windorski said in the comments section of the winner announcement post.
